How that limit works together with the Office / Office Group picker of the criteria screen is not stated (see unresolved).

legacy_corrections.text: The eight specific status checkboxes of the grid (Accepted, Rejected, Pending, Cancelled, Completed, In Progress, Not Needed, Expired) carry exactly the labels of the vendor's fixed status vocabulary of a referral case - Pending is the default status of a new case and Expired is set automatically after 30 days. The vocabulary has no further value, so another status checkbox below the third row is unlikely; whether anything else follows the grid is still unknown (see unresolved). The vocabulary is documented for the Referral Management utility: that the checkboxes filter the Referral Status of the case is the expected reading, and no vendor screenshot shows the criteria of this report.
